action.objective: Verify b2c3 (recapture on c3) as single candidate to resolve the check and consolidate material.
action.rationale: Position: White is in check from the dark-squared bishop on c3. Legal moves are only b2c3 (pawn recaptures bishop), f4d2 (block with bishop), or d1d2 (block with queen). Broad search already completed with exact score -39 for b2c3, best among candidates; f4d2 and d1d2 scored much worse and are only upper bounds. b2c3 is the natural recapture, removing the checking bishop while opening the b-file and keeping material roughly level (White has lost the exchange after Nxc6? No: White knight captured on c6, Black bishop took c3, bxc3 restores; material: White has N+2B vs Black R+B? Let's verify in search). Need single-candidate verification at max depth with full root window and mate probes.
